title: Builder Design groups and small rich text

entries.summary: moduleCatalog lists design packs per type. Text/CTA/Blurb/Accordion/Tabs bodies run through sanitizeRichText (allowlisted p/br/strong/em/u/ul/ol/li/a; script and javascript: dropped). Heading stays escaped plain text.

Inspector Design tab hides packs the module does not list. wysiwyg.js (loaded before panel.js) supplies Bold/Italic/list/Link. Canvas text modules save innerHTML. normalizeModuleCatalog passes the design array through data-modules.
No schema change. Rich markup lives in existing layout_json data fields and restores with the SQL dump. Public HTML is re-allowlisted at render time.
